In many cases, such differences usually come from specific policy conditions like non-payable items (consumables), or charges being higher than insurer’s reasonable & customary limits. That said, without reviewing the full documents (discharge summary, final bill, and settlement letter), it’s difficult to comment on whether the deduction was fair or not. If you feel the deduction is incorrect, you can:

comments.text:
I bought the HDFC Ergo Optima Secure family floater policy for my brother after watching all those “expert” videos on YouTube from channels like Law Advisor and Ditto Insurance. They made it sound like the best policy in the market. We trusted them and paid ₹75,000 upfront for a 3-year policy with a ₹20 lakh sum insured plus ₹20 lakh extra cover from day one.

Then reality hit.

My brother met with a road accident and fractured his knee, requiring an urgent implant surgery. No alcohol involved, no traffic violation, and the MLC was completely clean. Everything was straightforward medically and legally.

But dealing with HDFC Ergo was a nightmare.

For pre-approval, they made us wait more than 40 hours.  
First 24 hours for the surveyor visit, and after the surveyor submitted his report, they took another 16+ hours just to approve the claim.

During this time I kept calling them non-stop. Every executive repeated the same script:  
“Sir, please wait for 2 hours… we are raising a ticket.”

Calls, emails, tweets, grievances — everything was done. Still nothing moved.

Imagine a person lying in hospital with a fractured leg in severe pain, waiting endlessly because an insurance company is “processing”.

And the worst part?  
Their executives actually suggested going for reimbursement and paying the hospital bill ourselves first.

Seriously? If someone has a major accident with a ₹20–30 lakh treatment cost, and they somehow arrange money hoping reimbursement will come later, what if the insurer later finds some document excuse or technical loophole and rejects it?

That person could literally lose their savings, property, or life security because of this system.

After surgery, the hospital submitted the final bill at 1 PM, and even then HDFC took 9 hours to clear it. The call center told me it could take up to 48 hours.

So a patient with a fresh knee surgery and severe pain had to wait 10 more hours just for discharge approval.

Finally we left the hospital at 11 PM and reached home around midnight.

This has been my real experience with HDFC Ergo. After paying such a huge premium and following all rules, the service was slow, frustrating, and completely insensitive.

For me now, HDFC Ergo is one of the most disappointing insurance companies I’ve dealt with.

Don’t blindly trust influencer videos and sponsored recommendations. Real experiences only come out when you actually need the insurance.

And one more thing I realized:  
If this had been a corporate group policy, approval probably would have come in 30 minutes.

But for an individual policyholder paying from his own pocket — you’re just another ticket number in their system.

They are promoting a video making a hell amount of money and we as a consumer are paying for this.

comments.text: Hi, thanks for asking this question. In HDFC ERGO Optima Secure, the “4× cover” is neither a lifetime accumulated bonus nor a one-time pot that vanishes forever after a claim. It works policy-year wise and in layers. With a ₹10 lakh base cover, you start with ₹20 lakh on day one. Over renewals, this increases step by step and the final layer appears only after a claim is paid and the cover is refilled. So the full 4× is not available upfront in one go. If you end up using the entire cover in the 4th policy year and when you renew into the 5th year, the cover structure resets as per policy terms. You do not permanently fall back to just ₹10 lakh. At the same time, these benefits don’t accumulate forever either. Any unused portion in a year does not carry forward. The 4× cover should be seen as annual layered protection, not “₹10 lakh turning into ₹40 lakh anytime”. Optima Secure is a solid plan  but it’s best to evaluate it on base cover, core benefits and claim usability and treat these boosters as complementary rather than the main reason to buy. The best fit in health insurance always depends on individual circumstances.

comments.text: Hi! The Secure Benefit in Optima Secure is not considered part of the base Sum Insured. It’s an additional 100% cover added on top of your base Sum Insured right from day one. So, if your base cover is ₹10 lakhs, the Secure Benefit adds another ₹10 lakhs, giving you a total cover of ₹20 lakhs from day 1 for that policy year. The base sum insured, however, remains the original amount you selected - ₹10 lakhs in this case.

comments.text: Hi! As per IRDAI standard exclusion, expenses related to the treatment for correction of eyesight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres are excluded under health insurance. It’s usually excluded because it’s an elective or planned procedure done mostly for cosmetic or lifestyle reasons. So, if LASIK surgery performed solely for cosmetic or vision correction (removal of spectacles) below 7.5 dioptres, the claim would not be admissible. However, if the refractive error is 7.5 dioptres or higher, and the treatment is medically necessary, it may be covered.

comments.text: Hi, That’s a very thoughtful perspective. You’re right-no one really wants to ever use such a large cover and maintaining a healthy lifestyle should always be the first priority. At the same time, health insurance isn’t about expecting illness but about keeping a financial cushion for those rare and unpredictable situations where costs can suddenly run very high. Health insurance is only meant as a financial shield for extreme medical bills that can easily run into lakhs or crores in today’s times, especially in metro hospitals. The real challenge is that many people shy away from planning for such misfortunes - something the latest IBAI report also highlights as a reason for poor health coverage in India. The goal should be simple: keep a solid safety net in place and then focus peacefully on living a healthy, fulfilling life.
